method: Expert reviewer adopts fictional player perspectives while inspecting the actual app; these are not quotes from human participants.
accountCreation: Ten actual local registered accounts using public APIs; 31 approved setup matches plus a separately published return-visit match.

personas.name: Asha First-Time Player
personas.goal: I want to know what this app does and get my first credible rating.
personas.appraisal: The opening tells me to record real matches, shows all five reveal steps and gives me one route to find people. There is no unexplained provisional number.
personas.remaining: Five confirmations is a real initial commitment; the full rules need the short rating guide.

personas.name: Ben Club Regular
personas.goal: I want to compare with familiar players without treating every match as a professional tournament.
personas.appraisal: A real named friend is immediately attached to my doubles rating. My peak and next league are clear; real outcomes make the feed meaningful.
personas.remaining: Other categories in All play require careful reading, and $20 every month would still need a stronger personal value case.

personas.name: Chloe Singles Competitor
personas.goal: I want a fair singles comparison and a reason to check whether my friends caught me.
personas.appraisal: The supported point gap, category-specific circle and genuine published achievements make my progress understandable. A friend story opens its own category without moving my home selection.
personas.remaining: Developing estimates remain uncertain; new play from my actual friends drives the return loop.

personas.name: Dev Doubles Specialist
personas.goal: I want the app to consider both teams and distinguish partners naturally.
personas.appraisal: Actual varied-partner matches publish a doubles estimate, shared stories retain the real participants, and acknowledgement leads into the private encouragement flow.
personas.remaining: The home cannot reduce pair dependence to a simple universal skill number; partner diversity matters.

personas.name: Ella Club Organiser
personas.goal: I want my regular group to feel recognizable and to compare people responsibly.
personas.appraisal: The named group, actual crest and member count are visible on home and open the specific group directly. Review duties are not lost merely because they are old.
personas.remaining: Group identity does not yet provide a strong ongoing ritual or qualified neighborhood crown.

personas.name: Farah Private Player
personas.goal: I want progress with friends while controlling public exposure and location.
personas.appraisal: Accepted-friend activity is explicit, the local link respects my opt-out, and sharing opens the actual privacy and preview controls. Pressure can be reduced through break mode.
personas.remaining: Saved public snapshots require their existing revocation controls; friends still see the limited category progress described by the product.

personas.name: Gabe Returning Player
personas.goal: I want to see what changed without rereading everything or being punished for time away.
personas.appraisal: A newly approved match appears once in my since-check summary, two friends stay grouped, Caught up persists through reload, and a failed refresh remains visible with retry.
personas.remaining: The acknowledgement baseline is per device; a quiet playing circle yields little new content.

personas.name: Harper Enlarged Text
personas.goal: I need readable type and usable controls on a narrow phone.
personas.appraisal: The actual 200% text setting at 320px has readable wrapping, no horizontal overflow and reachable recording, category and navigation actions. Motion is optional.
personas.remaining: The opening and navigation are much taller; real assistive technology and physical phones are not represented by viewport emulation.

personas.name: Iris Fixed Partnership
personas.goal: I always play with the same partner and need to understand what my five-match rating really means.
personas.appraisal: The real fifth confirmed doubles match reveals a number with Pair-linked status. The expanded circle explains why individual comparison is withheld.
personas.remaining: The published estimate does not fully separate my contribution from my regular partner.

personas.name: Jae Regular Partner
personas.goal: I want my result history recognized without an unjustified individual position.
personas.appraisal: My regular partnership is represented honestly and the social feed and group stay useful even though the opening numerical rivalry is absent.
personas.remaining: An ordinary individual comparison needs varied partnerships and supporting shared evidence.
